mainHtml:
The iconic “Swedish Brick” reborn with a Volvo V8 and manual transmission

Featured cars
Reborn 1980 Volvo 240, upgraded with a roaring Volvo V8 and combined with uprated brakes and a proper chassis. Clocking just around 499km since its rebirth, this Swedish Brick is reincarnated with a discreet look and enough power to outrun more aerodynamic opponents.
Bidders HighwayDecember 14, 2023 12:00
Sporting Volvos own V8, the V84444S engine built together with Yamaha, pumping out about 315hp and paired with a proper 6-speed manual gearbox. Upgraded with a uprated chassis for those summer runs on your favourite backroads, a multi- plate diff for quick 0-100 sprints and large brakes for quick ice-cream stops.


Looking sharp with a fantastic looking paint job from 1990, it's rust-free and tidy, except for minor scratches on the bumpers. Inside, it's well-kept, featuring sport seats, Volvo-GT gauges, a classy Nardi wooden steering wheel, and a slick control system screen for all the information needed.

Under the hood, the engine's tip-top with a new rally-style clutch in 2023, while brakes are as good as new.


We highly recommend you to visit the auction page to view all the photos and the rest of the information of this stunning Swedish Brick!
